description: Kenwood TM-D710A clone image: 1032 memories, radio-wide / PM0–PM5 settings, VFOs, APRS, and tail PM names

ui.label: Band code
ui.description: Band identifier stored with this memory. The radio uses it to recall the channel on the correct side.

ui.label: Scan skip
ui.description: Skips this memory during scan. The channel stays programmed and can still be selected directly.

ui.label: Tuning step (kHz)
ui.description: How far the frequency moves for each click of the tuning control, in kHz.

ui.label: Mode
ui.description: FM is wide FM. NFM is narrow FM. AM is for air-band and other AM channels.

ui.label: Duplex
ui.description: Repeater shift for this memory. Blank is simplex. + or − uses the offset. Split stores a separate transmit frequency.

ui.label: Split TX step (kHz)
ui.description: Tuning step used for the split transmit frequency, in kHz.

ui.label: Remote control answerback
ui.description: The radio replies on the PC port when a remote controller polls it.

ui.label: Current PM select
ui.description: Programmable memory (PM) recalled at power-on. 0 is PM0, the profile you are editing. 1 through 5 are the other stored profiles.

ui.label: Panel lock
ui.description: Locks the front-panel keys. The microphone PTT still works. This is the panel key-lock state, separate from microphone key lock (menu 513).

ui.label: Display memory channel number
ui.description: Shows the memory channel number on the display while a memory is recalled.

ui.label: 10 MHz mode
ui.description: Tunes in 10 MHz steps so you can jump across a band quickly.

ui.label: Microphone sensitivity
ui.description: Microphone gain. High is the most sensitive. Low keeps the transmitted audio from being too loud or picking up cabin noise.

ui.label: Repeater mode
ui.description: Cross-band repeater direction. Cross Band repeats both ways. The locked choices transmit on one side and receive on the other.

ui.label: Repeater transmit hold
ui.description: Keeps the cross-band repeater transmitting for a moment after the input signal drops.

ui.label: Repeater ID transmit
ui.description: Sends the repeater ID while cross-band repeat is on. Off sends nothing. Morse sends the ID as CW. Voice speaks it.

ui.label: PC port baud rate
ui.description: Baud rate of the PC port used for programming and control. The computer program must use the same speed.

ui.label: Password enabled
ui.description: Requires the power-on password before the radio will operate.

ui.label: Password
ui.description: Power-on password. Used only when the password is enabled.

ui.label: A: Left side VFO/MR
ui.description: What the left side is doing: VFO tuning, memory recall, the call channel, or weather.

ui.label: A-band transmit power
ui.description: Transmit power for the left side. High is 50 W, medium is about 10 W, and low is about 5 W.

ui.label: WX alert A-band
ui.description: Opens the squelch on the left side when a weather-alert tone is received.

ui.label: A-band S-meter SQL
ui.description: S-meter squelch for the left side. The speaker opens only when the signal is at least as strong as the S-meter setting.

ui.label: A: Left side MR channel
ui.description: Memory channel selected on the left side when that side is in memory recall.

ui.label: B: Right side VFO/MR
ui.description: What the right side is doing: VFO tuning, memory recall, the call channel, or weather.

ui.label: B-band transmit power
ui.description: Transmit power for the right side. High is 50 W, medium is about 10 W, and low is about 5 W.

ui.label: WX alert B-band
ui.description: Opens the squelch on the right side when a weather-alert tone is received.

ui.label: B-band S-meter SQL
ui.description: S-meter squelch for the right side. The speaker opens only when the signal is at least as strong as the S-meter setting.

ui.label: B: Right side MR channel
ui.description: Memory channel selected on the right side when that side is in memory recall.

ui.label: SQC logic
ui.description: Polarity of the squelch-control output on the data jack. Match this to the device listening for busy or squelch.

ui.label: TX side (PTT)
ui.description: Which side transmits when you press PTT. A is the left side. B is the right side.

ui.label: Single band display
ui.description: Shows only one side on the display. Turn this off to see both A and B.

ui.label: Mute
ui.description: Mutes the speaker. The radio still receives.

ui.label: PM power-on message
ui.description: Message shown at power-on. The stored value selects the profile text: 1 is the current profile, and 2 through 6 are PM 1 through PM 5.

ui.label: Group link
ui.description: Memory groups that scan together. Enter the group digits you want linked.

ui.label: Beep on
ui.description: Beeps when you press a key or turn a control.

ui.label: Beep volume
ui.description: How loud the key beep is. 1 is quietest.

ui.label: External speaker
ui.description: How the external speaker jack is used. Mode 1 and Mode 2 choose which band audio is sent to the external speaker.

ui.label: Announce mode
ui.description: Voice announcements. Off is silent. Auto speaks when you change frequency or memory. Manual speaks when you press the announce key.

ui.label: Announce language
ui.description: Language used for voice announcements.

ui.label: Voice volume
ui.description: How loud the voice announcements are. 1 is quietest.

ui.label: Voice speed
ui.description: How fast the voice announcements speak. 0 is slowest and 4 is fastest.

ui.label: VGS playback repeat
ui.description: Repeats VGS-1 voice-recorder playback instead of playing the clip once.

ui.label: VGS playback interval (s)
ui.description: Seconds between repeated VGS-1 playbacks when playback repeat is on.

ui.label: Continuous recording
ui.description: The VGS-1 keeps recording receive audio so you can play back the last transmission.

ui.label: VHF band AIP
ui.description: Advanced Intercept Point on VHF. Turn this on when strong nearby signals overload the receiver. Sensitivity is slightly lower.

ui.label: UHF band AIP
ui.description: Advanced Intercept Point on UHF. Turn this on when strong nearby signals overload the receiver. Sensitivity is slightly lower.

ui.label: S-meter SQL hang time (ms)
ui.description: How long S-meter squelch stays open after the signal drops below the threshold. Off closes immediately.

ui.label: RX mute hang time (ms)
ui.description: How long the speaker stays muted after the mute condition clears. Off releases the mute immediately.

ui.label: Beat shift
ui.description: Shifts an internal oscillator so a birdie moves off the frequency you want to hear.

ui.label: Time-out timer (min)
ui.description: Stops a transmission that runs longer than this, so a stuck microphone cannot hold the channel.

ui.label: Memory recall method
ui.description: Which memories the tuning control steps through. All Bands includes every memory. Current Band stays on the band you are using.

ui.label: EchoLink speed
ui.description: How fast EchoLink DTMF memory is sent. Fast is the usual setting. Slow gives the link more time between digits.

ui.label: DTMF hold
ui.description: Keeps the transmitter keyed for a moment after a DTMF memory finishes, so the last digit is not cut off.

ui.label: DTMF speed
ui.description: How fast DTMF memory digits are sent.

ui.label: DTMF pause (ms)
ui.description: Length of the pause inserted when a DTMF memory contains a pause.

ui.label: DTMF lock
ui.description: Locks the DTMF keypad so digits are not sent by accident.

ui.label: Auto repeater offset
ui.description: Applies the standard repeater offset when you tune into a repeater sub-band.

ui.label: 1750 Hz transmit hold
ui.description: Holds transmit while a 1750 Hz tone burst is sent, for repeaters that open on that tone.

ui.label: Brightness
ui.description: Display brightness. 0 turns the backlight off. 1 is the dimmest lit level and 8 is the brightest.

ui.label: Auto brightness
ui.description: Dims the display automatically when the surroundings are dark.

ui.label: Backlight color
ui.description: Backlight color, amber or green.

ui.label: Front panel PF1
ui.description: Function assigned to the front-panel PF1 key.

ui.label: Front panel PF2
ui.description: Function assigned to the front-panel PF2 key.

ui.label: Microphone PF1
ui.description: Function assigned to microphone PF1.

ui.label: Microphone PF2
ui.description: Function assigned to microphone PF2.

ui.label: Microphone PF3
ui.description: Function assigned to microphone PF3.

ui.label: Microphone PF4
ui.description: Function assigned to microphone PF4.

ui.label: Microphone key lock
ui.description: Locks the microphone keys so they are not pressed by accident. The front panel still works.

ui.label: Scan resume
ui.description: What scan does after it stops on a signal. Time resumes after a pause. Carrier resumes when the signal drops. Seek stops and stays.

ui.label: Auto power off (min)
ui.description: Turns the radio off after this many minutes with no operation. Off disables it.

ui.label: External TNC band
ui.description: Which side is connected to an external TNC on the data jack.

ui.label: External TNC baud
ui.description: Packet speed for the external TNC, 1200 or 9600 baud.

ui.label: SQC output source
ui.description: What the squelch-control pin reports: receiver busy, squelch open, transmit, or a combination.

ui.label: Auto PM store
ui.description: Stores the current settings into the programmable memory automatically.

ui.label: Display partition bar
ui.description: Shows the partition bar between the left and right sides of the display.

ui.label: Contrast
ui.description: Display contrast. Higher levels make the characters easier to see at an angle.

ui.label: Color mode
ui.description: Positive is dark characters on a light field. Negative reverses that.

ui.label: Visual scan
ui.description: How many channels visual scan draws across the display. Wider modes cover more spectrum at once.

ui.label: Internal TNC band
ui.description: Which side the built-in TNC uses for packet and APRS.

ui.label: WX alert scan time (min)
ui.description: How often weather-alert scan checks the weather channels, in minutes. Off disables the timed scan. The alert itself is menu 110.

ui.label: Scan TO delay (s)
ui.description: Seconds scan pauses on a signal when scan resume is Time. Menu 514 selects the resume method.

ui.label: Scan CO delay (s)
ui.description: Seconds scan waits after a carrier drops when scan resume is Carrier. Menu 514 selects the resume method.

ui.label: A/Left: 118 MHz
ui.description: Allows the left side to tune the 118 MHz band.

ui.label: A/Left: 144 MHz
ui.description: Allows the left side to tune the 144 MHz band.

ui.label: A/Left: 220 MHz
ui.description: Allows the left side to tune the 220 MHz band.

ui.label: A/Left: 300 MHz
ui.description: Allows the left side to tune the 300 MHz band.

ui.label: A/Left: 430 MHz
ui.description: Allows the left side to tune the 430 MHz band.

ui.label: B/Right: 144 MHz
ui.description: Allows the right side to tune the 144 MHz band.

ui.label: B/Right: 220 MHz
ui.description: Allows the right side to tune the 220 MHz band.

ui.label: B/Right: 300 MHz
ui.description: Allows the right side to tune the 300 MHz band.

ui.label: B/Right: 430 MHz
ui.description: Allows the right side to tune the 430 MHz band.

ui.label: B/Right: 800 MHz
ui.description: Allows the right side to tune the 800 MHz band.

ui.label: VFO frequency (Hz)
ui.description: Frequency for this VFO, in Hz.

ui.label: VFO tuning step (kHz)
ui.description: Tuning step for this VFO, in kHz.

ui.label: VFO mode
ui.description: Modulation for this VFO. FM is wide FM, NFM is narrow FM, and AM is for air-band reception.

ui.label: VFO duplex
ui.description: Repeater shift for this VFO. Blank is simplex. + or − uses the offset. Split uses a separate transmit frequency.

ui.label: VFO low limit (Hz)
ui.description: Lowest frequency this programmable VFO will tune, in Hz.

ui.label: VFO high limit (Hz)
ui.description: Highest frequency this programmable VFO will tune, in Hz.

ui.label: DTMF code
ui.description: DTMF digits stored in this memory. The microphone can send the whole string.

ui.label: DTMF name
ui.description: Name shown for this DTMF memory.

ui.label: Repeater ID
ui.description: Callsign sent as the cross-band repeater ID. Menu 406 chooses Morse, voice, or off.

ui.label: PM group name
ui.description: Name of this programmable memory. PM 1 through PM 5 are the stored profiles.

ui.label: PM list name
ui.description: Name shown in the programmable-memory list for PM 1 through PM 5.

ui.label: Comment
ui.description: Note stored with this profile. It is for you; the radio does not transmit it.

ui.label: My callsign
ui.description: Callsign used for APRS beacons and messages. This is menu 600 in the APRS basic settings.

ui.label: My SSID
ui.description: SSID added to the APRS callsign so this radio is distinct from your other stations. None sends the callsign alone.

ui.label: Status text enabled
ui.description: Sends the APRS status text. Off beacons position without that text.

ui.label: Status text
ui.description: Status text included with APRS beacons, such as a route or operating note.

ui.label: Message group
ui.description: Message groups this station accepts, such as ALL, QST, CQ, or a club group. Other groups are filtered out.

ui.label: APRS comment
ui.description: Position comment sent with the APRS beacon, such as Off Duty or En Route.

ui.label: Commander call sign
ui.description: Callsign of the Sky Command commander station.

ui.label: Transporter call sign
ui.description: Callsign of the Sky Command transporter station.

ui.label: Sky Command tone (Hz)
ui.description: CTCSS tone the commander and transporter share so Sky Command audio is not heard by every receiver on the frequency.
